supersedes.change: rank-2 event-family law advances v1 (family-implicit disposition) to v2 (explicit authenticated-family-fact law with provider-transported topic binding); no route, divergence, or precedence change

governing_note: B2.6-P2 Corrective XIX (H-XIX-R6): the explicit machine-readable authority hierarchy for provider contracts. A payload must never be simultaneously 'valid per the public provider contract' and 'semantically invalid per the sovereign reconciliation law' without a governed scope rule below explaining the difference. Precedence is top-down: (1) sovereign reconciliation law, (2) sovereign event-family law v2 (explicit authenticated family facts; familyless shapes refused), (3) public ingestion API surface (transport only), (4) legacy provider shape law (superseded where divergent). This artifact is versioned: hierarchy changes that alter P2 authority require a new contract_version (never an in-place edit), recorded in the publication-history chain and the b26_p2_publication_history ledger.

precedence.role: sovereign reconciliation law: what counts as P2 financial truth (shapes, money, identity, goldens, refusals)
sovereign event-family law: which provider event families may found financial authority, and which authenticated fact proves each family
public ingestion API surface: transport/shape advertisement only. Non-authoritative for meaning; any shape it advertises outside rank-1/2 support is ingestion-rejected (DLQ), never coerced.
legacy provider shape law: SUPERSEDED wherever it diverges from rank 1. Retained for history; divergent entries are classified superseded_legacy below and are not served.

superseded_legacy_entries.rationale: charge.succeeded is outside the sovereign supported families (rank 1 supports payment_intent.succeeded only); no implemented route serves it; ranked lower than the sovereign law per precedence.
legacy path naming diverges from the served route /webhooks/paypal/sale_completed; the served route and the sovereign flat-sale shape govern. Rank-1/2 win on any divergence.
order/created is outside the sovereign supported families (rank 1 supports order.completed only); only order_completed is served.
legacy path naming diverges from the served route /webhooks/shopify/order_create; same sovereign family (orders.create). The served route governs.

the public schema advertises a resource envelope the sovereign law refuses (refusal vector paypal-resource-envelope). Rank 1 wins: such payloads are DLQ-routed, never coerced. The divergence is declared here, not hidden.

the public schema enumerates families outside sovereign support; only payment_intent.succeeded (and its underscored relay variant) founds authority. Non-sovereign families are DLQ-routed at the relay and refused at the root.

superseded_law_versions.rationale: v1 permitted family-implicit authority for signal-less shapes; v2 requires an explicit authenticated family fact. Pre-XIX mints keep their bound value tagged xix-backfill:pre-xix-mint per the v2 migration law.
v1 ranked the v1 family law; v2 ranks the v2 family law. No route or divergence change.

projection_rule: provider ingestion contract DOWN-PROJECTS to the P2 reconciliation subset: P2-supported = implemented route AND authenticated family fact AND sovereign shape. Anything else is ingestion-only (DLQ/ignore) or superseded. No route existence implies P2 authority; no provider name implies family.
